segments.he:
(צה) אָמַרעַל אַנְשֵׁי-שְׁלוֹמֵנוּ שֶׁקָּשֶׁה לָהֶם שֶׁיָּרִימוּ אֶת עַצְמָן לְהַנְהִיג בְּרַבָּנוּת  וְהִתְנַשְּׂאוּת  מֵחֲמַת
שֶׁהִכְנַסְתִּי בָּהֶם אֱמֶת הַרְבֵּה יוֹתֵר מִדַּי:
תקלט
segments.en: (105.) Once he said to me when I was standing alone before him: "Eliyahu filled his heart and called the Holy One Blessed be He 'the Cause of all causes and the Foundation of all foundations'" — and he said in Yiddish in these words: "He is der Veigenish." And I do not know well the meaning of this word.
